title: Formatting and Routing Profile
description: A schema defining formatting rules for various channels and routing logic for Grasshopper.

sms_formatting_rules.description: Rules for formatting SMS messages (e.g., use of emojis, capital letters, line breaks).

email_formatting_rules.description: Rules for formatting emails (e.g., bolding, bullet points, font constraints).

webchat_formatting_rules.description: Rules for formatting webchat messages (e.g., markdown support, link formatting).

phone_script_formatting_rules.description: Rules for formatting phone scripts (e.g., phonetic spelling for names, pause markers).

grasshopper_routing_rules.description: Specific rules for call routing within the Grasshopper phone system.

grasshopper_sms_rules.description: Specific handling rules for SMS messages received or sent via Grasshopper.
